history.ancient: Inhabited by Germanic tribes such as the Batavians and Frisians; Southern regions were incorporated into the Roman Empire as Germania Inferior.
history.medieval: Part of the Frankish Empire, later splitting into semi-independent fiefdoms under the Holy Roman Empire, including the Duchy of Brabant and County of Holland.
history.earlyModern: Seceded from Spanish rule following the Eighty Years' War (1568–1648), giving rise to the Dutch Golden Age as a global maritime and economic power.
history.modern: Transformed into a constitutional monarchy under the House of Orange-Nassau, maintained neutrality in WWI, occupied in WWII, and became a founding member of the EU and NATO.

timeline.event: Declaration of Independence (Act of Abjuration) from Spain.
Establishment of the Dutch East India Company (VOC).
Peace of Westphalia recognizes full Dutch independence.
Establishment of the Kingdom of the Netherlands.
German occupation during World War II.
Netherlands becomes a founding member of the European Economic Community (EEC).

government.parliament: States General (Senate / First Chamber and House of Representatives / Second Chamber)
government.constitution: Constitution of the Kingdom of the Netherlands (1815, major revision in 1983)

literature: Anne Frank (The Diary of a Young Girl)
